versions.changelog:
Initial release of pan-pac travel agent skill

- Handles email, calendar, and booking tasks related to Pan Pacific Travel.
- Specializes in extracting key booking information from communications (dates, destinations, passengers, statuses, etc.).
- Delegates booking system operations to lynx-skill and email/calendar operations to outlook-entra.
- Provides clear guidelines for handling different types of contacts (internal staff, external agencies, providers, and rare direct clients).
